name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.card_bad_stacked
title: Lambda^perp([I_l (x) B | W]) is smooth for most uniform (B, W)
statement: For a prime q, tau >= 1, 2 tau <= q and 3 m exp(-pi tau^2) <= 1/2, the number of pairs (B, W) in Z_q^{n x m} x Z_q^{ln x m} with dualMassE([I_l (x) B | W], tau) > 1/2 is at most q^{nm} q^{lnm} * 4(l+1)(12 m exp(-pi tau^2) + (q^n + q^{ln})(4/tau)^m).
